lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.transport: Shared owner source/constraint metadata; not an APK input or runtime filesystem exchange.
value.statement: LISA change-impact review spans launcher and roles, templates and tenant overlays, PostgreSQL/QLR relations and triggers, NGW/Collector fields and portable form rules, diagnostic and usage queues, app/library variants, APK publication identity and saved updater/draft state. Read exact source evidence and conditions from the shared scenario/resource registries and layer-resource-audit; preserve protected consumers and unknown provider/runtime branches. These records describe separate conditional contracts rather than a single runtime pipeline. Static mapping and docs validation do not certify installed state, native acceptance, delivery or publication, and do not authorize edits of another owner's dirty source tree.
